Hi, I am Hans, a student in the Master of Data Science program at UBC. Before joining MDS, I studied statistics and mathematics at the University of Toronto. My interests are quantitative finance and machine learning, and I hope to connect my mathematical background with practical skills in data analysis and modelling. This website is a place to share my learning and experiences throughout the program.
